lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.h: Benford and Dorian Williams out; Kincaid doubtful vs. Miami
news.b: Friday's final report ruled out CB Christian Benford (groin) and LB Dorian Williams (calf), neither of whom practiced all week; Joe Brady doesn't think either injury is long term. TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is doubtful, the same status Spencer Brown had last week before he played. S Damar Hamlin (toe), TE Jackson Hawes (shoulder) and DL T.J. Sanders (shoulder) are questionable.

news.h: Elarms-Orr gets first start; Alford cleared
news.b: Rookie LB Kaleb Elarms-Orr, who has played in every game this season, will make his first NFL start in place of Williams. CB Dee Alford cleared the concussion protocol and practiced fully Friday, and WR Tyrell Shavers, S Cole Bishop and G O'Cyrus Torrence carry no game status.

news.h: Dolphins add Daniel Carlson; punter Pinion out
news.b: Miami signed former All-Pro K Daniel Carlson to its practice squad after waiving Zane Gonzalez. Carlson was 14-of-18 on field goals for New Orleans before his Nov. 3 release. P Bradley Pinion (groin) and WR Jared Wayne (quad) are out, so practice-squad P Jack Browning is the fallback, and C Aaron Brewer (concussion) is questionable after practicing fully Friday.

news.h: Salute to Service and Rivalries uniforms Sunday
news.b: The Bills will wear their Rivalries uniforms for Sunday's 1 p.m. CBS game at Highmark Stadium, with a cold front moving in. Black Hawk and Apache helicopters from Fort Drum's 10th Combat Aviation Brigade will do the flyover, James Lofton is the Legend of the Game, and five Purple Heart recipients will be honored at halftime.

source: buffalobills.com Week 11 final injury report (Fri, Nov 20) and Highmark Stadium game-day preview; miamidolphins.com Week 11 injury report; Yahoo Sports on Carlson, Brewer and Pinion (Nov 19). Checked Nov 21: no AFC East game since the last update (Thursday's game was Colts-Texans).
